name: Louise
text: Well I do not have the words to explain how grateful I am to have found such a caring, loving and knowledgeable dog minder. I have struggled to find an environment that was suitable with having a small and large dog, quite the odd combination, however, Linda put my mind at total ease with regular updates and lovely pictures/videos. As we all know, having fur babies and entrusting them to a new minder is always quite nerve wrecking for us humans. I can hand in heart say dogs speak for themselves, so much so on one collection day Co Co ran back to go with Linda😂 that’s all the confirmation I needed! I could not find the right words to recommend Linda for the service she provides as I don’t believe it exists any where else. Please any one looking for a day minder/holiday stay don’t go to anyone else this is a beautiful caring doggy retreat for them. So we can be at peace while they are enjoying themselves. Thank you agin Linda, see you soon ❤️❤️❤️

name: Nadya
text:
A wonderful home away from home! ❤️

When we had to spend an extended time away from Cyprus, finding the perfect place for our beloved Australian Shepherd, Hayley, was so important to us. With Linda and Michael, we found so much more than just dog boarding — we found a second home for our girl! ❤️

They welcomed Hayley with so much love and affection, embracing her clever personality, endless cuddles and even her little singing performances! 😂🎶

We especially loved following Hayley’s daily adventures through their Instagram Stories. Seeing how happy, relaxed and loved she was gave us incredible peace of mind, even from far away. 🥹❤️

At Linda’s Doggy Daycare, dogs aren’t simply looked after — they’re truly part of the family.

Dear Linda and Michael, thank you from the bottom of our hearts for loving Hayley as your own. You’ve earned a very special place in our hearts, too! ❤️

We’re sure Hayley is already looking forward to her next holiday with you — complete with cuddles, belly rubs and, of course, her famous concerts! 😂🐶🎶

We couldn’t recommend you more highly. Five stars simply aren’t enough! ⭐🐾

Sending you both big hugs and lots of Hayley kisses! ❤️
